mathematical_definition: (spread_t - mean(spreads in trailing 60s tick window)) / std(spreads in trailing 60s tick window) -- z-score of the current tick's spread against TickActivityTracker's own tick-level ring buffer (self._spreads), not a bar-level rolling window
numerical_stability_notes: Stateful: TickActivityTracker maintains self._times/self._spreads as two parallel deques appended together on every update() call and evicted together in the same while loop once a tick falls outside the trailing TICK_WINDOW_SEC=60.0s window -- always equal length, no drift possible. 0.0 returned (not a raw division) whenever std <= 1e-12 to avoid a divide-by-near-zero blow-up during quiet, low-variance spread stretches. Genuinely new for Task 21 (spec section 7) -- the 6.7-year historical CSV has no tick-level spread series, so this feature has no historical analogue and cannot be backfilled.
missing_value_policy: None until at least 2 ticks are in the trailing 60s window (need a defined mean/std to score against), never zero-filled
status_reason: no historical evidence exists or can exist for this feature; live data only since 2026-08-18 (Phase 2 live verification date)
